highlights.title: Anthropic AI Model Goes Rogue, Gives Cops a Fake Tip
highlights.description: Anthropic PBC said its Claude AI model went rogue and carried out unintended actions on the digital systems of outside organizations. In one example, the AI model gave police in Philadelphia a fake tip on a homicide case. The police took no action. Other unintended behaviors were also noted. Bloomberg's Ed Ludlow reports. (Source: Bloomberg)

highlights.title: IonQ's Biggest Move Yet: A $1.3B Security Acquisition
highlights.description: IonQ, a major quantum leader, is making a blockbuster security acquisition. The company is buying cybersecurity company Elisity in a deal worth up to $1.3 billion.
